```lean
CategoryTheory.Limits.PullbackCone.IsLimit.mk.{v, u} {C : Type u} [Category.{v, u} C] {X Y Z : C} {f : X ⟶ Z}
  {g : Y ⟶ Z} {W : C} {fst : W ⟶ X} {snd : W ⟶ Y} (eq : fst ≫ f = snd ≫ g) (lift : (s : PullbackCone f g) → s.pt ⟶ W)
  (fac_left : ∀ (s : PullbackCone f g), lift s ≫ fst = s.fst)
  (fac_right : ∀ (s : PullbackCone f g), lift s ≫ snd = s.snd)
  (uniq : ∀ (s : PullbackCone f g) (m : s.pt ⟶ W), m ≫ fst = s.fst → m ≫ snd = s.snd → m = lift s) :
  IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk fst snd eq)
```

`PullbackCone.mk` is a limit cone.
